os-propose: Run /openspec-propose for the existing OpenSpec change {id} (openspec/changes/{id}/). Goal: {goal}
os-apply: Run /openspec-apply-change for the OpenSpec change {id} (openspec/changes/{id}/). Implement every open task of tasks.md.
os-apply-fix:
Run /openspec-apply-change for the OpenSpec change {id} (openspec/changes/{id}/) in fix mode. Critical findings from openspec/changes/{id}/agent-smith/verify.md:
{findings}
os-verify: Run /openspec-verify-change for the OpenSpec change {id} (openspec/changes/{id}/) and write openspec/changes/{id}/agent-smith/verify.md.
os-archive: Archive the OpenSpec change {id} with the OpenSpec CLI.
